patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Spocket and AliDrop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Spocket only if your buying job matches “US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.99/mo, Unic” rather than AliDrop's shape. Choose AliDrop only if your buying job matches “AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empire $99/mo,” rather than Spocket's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Spocket is shaped for US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Em whereas AliDrop is shaped for AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $5. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Spocket and AliDrop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Spocket is US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.99/mo, Unicorn $299.99/mo; 7-day trial; product caps per tier; AliDrop is AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empire $99/mo, Unicorn $299/mo; $1 for 7-day trial on paid tiers.
- Researched limits: Spocket — Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar; AliDrop — Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required.

Limitations — Spocket: Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar; Product caps force tier upgrades as catalog grows; AliDrop: Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required; Shipping times and quality vary by marketplace supplier.

Poor-fit cases: Spocket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar · AliDrop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required · Avoid Spocket if you actually need AliDrop's motion (AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empi)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
